errors.text_span: 且“D”类被视觉放大以突出其内部构成
errors.evidence: The description claims that slice 'D' is visually enlarged. In the figure, slice 'D' itself is not enlarged or exploded; rather, its sub-categories are detailed in a separate, second pie chart to the right.

errors.text_span: 各扇区按比例大小大致顺时针排列
errors.evidence: The description claims the slices in the main pie chart are roughly arranged clockwise by size. This is incorrect. The order of slices, starting from the largest (D: 27.8%) and going clockwise, is D(27.8%), A(9%), B(25.3%), C(20.7%), E(10.1%), F(7.1%). This is not in descending or 'roughly' descending order.
